create.name: Lama Justin von Bujdoss
create.bio:
Lama Justin von Bujdoss is an American teacher of Tibetan tantric Buddhism and a chaplain, who leads Yangti Yoga Retreat Center in Buckland, Massachusetts, a centre for dark retreat that he set up with Dr. Nida Chenagtsang. He took repa vows in the Karma Kamtsang lineage from Goshir Gyaltsab Rinpoche in 2011, receiving the name Repa Dorje Odzer, and was ordained a ngakpa in the Yuthok Nyingthig line in 2023. His teaching centres on Mahamudra, Dzogchen and the lay yogi tradition of Milarepa, offered in forms that fit modern lives without diluting them.

From 2012 to 2017 he was resident lama of a Tsurphu dharma centre in New York. He then became the first staff chaplain at the New York City Department of Correction, later heading its chaplaincy and staff wellness division and bringing meditation to jail officers, and from 2018 to 2024 he blessed the dead buried on Hart Island, the city's public cemetery. He has also worked as a hospice chaplain and is trained in Clinical Pastoral Education. He wrote Modern Tantric Buddhism, has written widely for Tricycle and Lion's Roar, and now leads dark retreats, a monthly Mahamudra class and pilgrimages to Bhutan.

books.title: Modern Tantric Buddhism
books.author: Justin von Bujdoss
books.description: Essays on living Vajrayana practice today: how embodiment, authenticity and the lay yogi path of Tilopa and Milarepa can shape practice for Western students outside monastic life.

courses.title: Mandala Membership with Mahamudra for the People
courses.description: A monthly membership at Yangti that includes his two-hour Mahamudra for the People class every second Friday (recorded), the chance to book one-to-one or small-group time with him, and member discounts on Yangti events. Members choose a level that fits their means.

courses.title: Bhutan 2027: Pilgrimage to the Heart of Ati
courses.description: An eighteen-day pilgrimage from Paro to Bumthang and Thimphu, led by him with H.E. Chung Tulku Rinpoche, visiting sacred sites linked to the Yangti Nakpo dark retreat lineage. Meals, lodging, internal travel and visa fees within Bhutan are included; no prior practice is required.
courses.price: Early bird (to 31 Jan 2027) $8,950 single / $7,950 double; standard $9,950 / $8,950; $1,500 deposit

courses.title: Dark Retreat at Yangti
courses.description: Individual retreat in complete darkness at the Buckland centre, taught as a Dzogchen thögal practice in the Yangti Nakpo and Yuthok Nyingthig lines, with guidance from the centre's teachers. Places are by application.

free_resources.title: Yangti Online Sangha
free_resources.description: Free online group practice from his centre, timed to the lunar calendar, including an Ati Yoga session each full moon, open to anyone with no prior connection needed.
